production_closure.evidence: the compiler graph maps rawz's sole tiffz import to src/parser.zig; shipped ELF/Mach-O load metadata and the complete Nix runtime closure reject zlib, OpenJPEG, libjpeg, libjxl, jpegz, zstd, lerc, and lzwz

pef_huffman_sparse_code.scope: synthetic PEF private-Huffman stream with one assigned prefix; every injected one bit is invalid by the pre-mutation table
pef_huffman_sparse_code.qualification: This proves the bounded PEF entropy validator slice, not PEF container dispatch or any other RAW family.

pef_huffman_strict_stream.scope: strict syntax-to-end validation for Pentax compression 65535 with compression-aware dispatch, bounded AOC MakerNote table lookup, stable failure codes, and byte offsets
pef_huffman_strict_stream.qualification: The real-file measurement covers one CC0 Pentax K10D 12-bit compressed PEF. PackBits 32773 remains structural after tiffz decompression because arbitrary packed sample values carry no integrity signal.

uncompressed_14bit_words.scope: big-endian 14-bit Nikon CFA samples stored in contiguous 16-bit words; high-bit headroom is checked but black/white level metadata is unavailable
uncompressed_14bit_words.qualification: The real-file measurement covers the contiguous 14-bit uncompressed sensor strips of one CC0 Nikon D300 NEF. Uncompressed words remain structural even with valid levels because their unconstrained low bytes exceed the fleet's 10% any-legal-byte ceiling. It does not cover packed samples, row padding, or compressed NEF.

families.evidence: DNGVersion and TIFF structure are checked through tiffz; full lossless-JPEG sensor payload coverage is not established

compression-aware payload dispatch distinguishes TIFF PackBits 32773 from Pentax Huffman 65535; bounded AOC MakerNote lookup supplies the table and byte order; strict Huffman syntax-to-end validation passes a CC0 K10D stream and returns stable codes plus byte offsets

the proprietary CR2 raw-IFD pointer and bounded single-strip lossless-JPEG payload are located with exact host offsets; a CC0 EOS 20D stream is blocked because jpegz does not yet support Canon's two-component subsampled SOF3 layout

the NEF CFA SubIFD locator combines only contiguous strips and identifies uncompressed words versus Nikon compression 34713; the shared word validator checks byte order, exact extent, high-bit headroom, and optional black/white bounds; uncompressed words remain structural under the 10% any-legal-byte ceiling, while compressed Nikon Huffman syntax remains unsupported
